goals.title: First manufacturing run: profit at least 1M ISK on Antimatter Charge S

steps.text: Research the Antimatter Charge S BPO to ME 7 / TE 18
Buy materials for 1,200 runs (at yesterday's average prices)
Wednesday: start all 4 BPC jobs in parallel (300 runs each)
Record the profit: sales − materials − job and copy fees − research

goals.notes:
Invested ISK in ME/TE research on my Antimatter Charge S original (now ME 7, TE 18) and bought materials for 1,200 runs at yesterday's average prices. A copy job is making 4 BPCs of 300 runs each; when it ends on Wednesday I run all four in parallel.
Count profit as sales after tax and broker fee, minus materials, job and copy fees, and the research cost.
Running 4 jobs at once needs 4 manufacturing slots (Mass Production III).
